Frequently Asked Questions

How Much Does an IPTV UK Subscription Cost?

Plans start from £14.99 for the 1-month Starter Plan, up to £49.99 for our best-value 12-month Ultimate Plan. See the full breakdown of all four packages above.

Which Devices Are Supported?

Our IPTV subscription supports Firestick, Smart TVs, Android TV, MAG devices, smartphones, tablets, Windows PCs, and Mac computers.

Do You Offer HD and 4K Streaming?

Yes. Many channels and video-on-demand titles are available in HD, Full HD, and 4K quality depending on availability.

How Quickly Will I Receive My IPTV Subscription?

Activation details are typically delivered shortly after your order is completed.

Can I Watch Sports with IPTV?

Yes. IPTV subscriptions include access to a variety of sports channels covering football, cricket, boxing, UFC, Formula 1, tennis, and more.

Do I Need Technical Knowledge to Use IPTV?

No. IPTV setup is straightforward, and our Installation Guide covers step-by-step instructions for every supported device.

Which IPTV Player Is Best?

The best player depends on your device. We recommend IBO Player for Smart TVs, Android TV, and iOS, and IPTV Smarters Expert or 8K Player for Firestick and Windows PC.

Which IPTV Player Is Best for Firestick?

For Firestick, we recommend 8K Player, installed via the Downloader app, for the smoothest setup and playback.

What Is IPTV Smarters?

IPTV Smarters (including IPTV Smarters Pro and Expert) is a popular IPTV player app. You log in with the username and password from your activation email to stream live channels, movies, and series.

How Do I Get My IPTV Username and Password?

After choosing a plan and completing your order, your login details or activation information are sent to you shortly after signup, ready to enter into your chosen IPTV player.
